Class MinimaxStrategy

java.lang.Object
chess.ai.MinimaxStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
MoveStrategy
public class MinimaxStrategy extends Object implements MoveStrategy
A computer opponent that looks a fixed number of moves ahead using minimax search with alpha-beta pruning.

Minimax: to score one of my moves, assume the opponent replies with whichever move is worst for me, and so on down to depth half-moves; then score the leaf positions with BoardEvaluator. This is written in the compact negamax form: a position's score for one side is the negative of its score for the other side, so one method handles both players.

Alpha-beta pruning skips replies that cannot change the decision: once a reply is found that already makes a move worse than a move examined earlier, the rest of that move's replies are skipped. Trying captures first makes those cut-offs happen sooner.

Checkmate is scored as a huge value minus the number of half-moves needed, so the search prefers the fastest mate and the slowest loss.

  • Method Details

    • chooseMove

      public Move chooseMove(Board board, PieceColor side)
      Searches every legal move and returns the one with the best minimax score. Ties keep the first move found, so the result is deterministic.
      Specified by:
      chooseMove in interface MoveStrategy
      Parameters:
      board - a copy of the current position (not modified)
      side - the color to move
      Returns:
      the best move found, or null if there is no legal move

    • negamax

      private int negamax(Board board, PieceColor side, int remaining, int alpha, int beta, int ply)
      Scores a position for side by searching remaining more half-moves.
      Parameters:
      board - the position (a private copy that may be modified)
      side - the color to move in this position
      remaining - half-moves left to search
      alpha - the best score side is already guaranteed elsewhere
      beta - the score above which the opponent will avoid this position
      ply - half-moves from the root, used to prefer faster mates
      Returns:
      the position's score for side

    • orderedMoves

      private List<Move> orderedMoves(Board board, PieceColor side)
